vectors.name: hello/basic
vectors.description: Minimal Hello: protocol version 1, no capabilities, a bearer ticket (fake), no cached schema, no client schema, default params, not optimistic.

vectors.name: hello/full
vectors.description: Hello speaking versions 2 and 1 (2 preferred), datagrams capability, bearer ticket, the cached server schema hash, the client's own schema inline as [2, hash, schema], and params limiting the server to 2 leased streams and 64 concurrent calls.

vectors.name: hello/optimistic
vectors.description: Optimistic Hello (section 5.3): exactly one protocol version, the cached schema hash, optimistic = true.

vectors.name: welcome/unchanged
vectors.description: Welcome choosing version 1, datagrams, a fixed TEST session_id (00..0f), server props, schema offer [0, hash] (client's cached schema is current) and server params.

vectors.name: welcome/delta
vectors.description: Welcome with schema offer [1, hash, from, delta]: the delta of vector schema/delta-1-replace-part from the schema the client named.

message.doc: Attach a file to a note; the data travels as a byte token.

vectors.name: welcome/full
vectors.description: Welcome with the full canonical schema inline: [2, hash, schema].

vectors.name: welcome/out-of-band
vectors.description: Welcome telling the client to fetch the schema over HTTP: [3, hash, location]. The location uses the web profile URL with the hash in base64url without padding.

vectors.name: ready
vectors.description: Ready naming the server schema hash the client loaded.
